{{Top|leg}}
A '''starport''' was located in [[Falleen Throne|Throne]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. Under the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], only [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] on pilgrimage and Imperial traffic were permitted to use the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. While, once it was open to offworld [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] to import artwork and exotic fruits. As a result, multiple [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] operated around the planet, exporting [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] in offworld luxuries.<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
